title: Reconcile the golden dataset, deliberately and diff-first
description: The error channel changes every terminal artifact, so all five replay cases must be re-captured -- and two hand-authored integrity cases now state things that are false and must be RE-AUTHORED, not re-captured. This is the sprint where the temptation to run GOLDEN_CAPTURE=1 and commit without reading the diff is strongest, and where doing so would defeat the gate as surely as deleting it.

successCriteria.description: All five enforcement "replay" cases are re-captured via GOLDEN_CAPTURE=1 and pass; the commit message describes the diff field by field rather than merely stating that cases were re-captured.
pipeline-result-reports-success-with-no-error-channel.json is RE-AUTHORED -- its prose asserted behaviour the error channel has now removed, so a re-capture would preserve a false statement.
commit-refused-fail-closed-under-noop-gate.json is RE-AUTHORED to state what a fail-closed refusal now produces, including the errors array.
The replay-case count stays at or above GOLDEN_MIN_REPLAY_CASES, which is 5, and no case anywhere in this spec is relabelled from replay to integrity.
src/pge/golden/executor.test.ts's expectation that a truncated run THROWS is re-expressed as 'the case does not pass', since the spec-less path now resolves.
The blocking golden regression job passes end to end, dataset half and runtime half, against the reconciled dataset.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build are green.

nonGoals: Relabelling any failing replay case as integrity to get a green build -- the floor has zero slack at exactly 5 and this is explicitly forbidden.
Deleting a case to make the count work.
Adding new scenarios beyond the one sprint 7 captured.
stopConditions: A replay case cannot be made to pass by re-capture and the reason is a runtime defect rather than an expected artifact change -- stop and report the defect; do not re-author around it.
The dataset drops below the replay floor -- stop.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build are green, and every documentation claim added is backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: The distinction between re-CAPTURE and re-AUTHOR is the whole sprint. A replay case's expectation is captured from a real run, so a behaviour change legitimately rewrites it. An integrity case is hand-authored prose plus a partial pin set: when the behaviour it describes changes, the PROSE is now false and must be rewritten by a human-equivalent act of judgement -- re-capturing it is not even possible, since replaying a partial pin set throws MissingRecordingError at the first unpinned call. Read the two named files and rewrite what they claim. When you re-capture the five, read the resulting diff before committing and write down what moved.
evaluatorNotes: This sprint is where a green gate is least trustworthy, so verify the diff yourself. For each re-captured case, check the change is confined to the error channel and its consequences -- an unrelated artifact that moved is a finding. For the two re-authored cases, read their prose and confirm it describes current behaviour; a case that still claims PipelineResult has no error channel fails sc-8-2 regardless of whether the suite is green. Confirm the replay count by counting files with enforcement replay yourself. Confirm sc-8-5 by reading the rewritten assertion -- 'does not pass' and 'throws' are different claims and only one is now true.
